office: the Immigration Department, Freetown (the High Commission in London no longer processes ordinary passports, only issues the application form)

routes.label: at the Immigration office in Freetown

note: The Sierra Leone High Commission in London's Passport Services page (last modified 2 August 2023, read 2026-10-31): "Current fee for passport at the Immigration office in Freetown is $100." The fee is written in US dollars as the page gives it ("$", read as the US dollar, the currency in which Sierra Leone quotes the passport fee; payment in leones at the day's equivalent is not modelled). The High Commission no longer processes the issue or renewal of ordinary passports and sells only the application form (GBP 5.00, not modelled). The Immigration Department's own fees page (slid.gov.sl/passport-fees) answers this client 403 and its archived copy couldn't be fetched (the archive reset every request on 2026-10-31), so no later text was read to confirm the amount; the page gives no age bands, time or validity.

sources.title: Sierra Leone High Commission, London, Passport Services (last modified 2023-08-02)
sources.said: The High Commission wishes to inform all Sierra Leonean Citizens that as a government policy, it no longer processes applications for the issuance or renewal of ordinary passports. ... Fee for the Republic of Sierra Leone Passport Application Form: £5:00 ... Current fee for passport at the Immigration office in Freetown is $100.
